neighbours.label: the opening of a predicate complement after a copula in a reported claim ('that X is a/the ...'): the slot where the claim's verdict arrives
fire: Analysts argue that solar is the cheapest source of power.
Researchers believe that this compound is a strong candidate for trials.
He insists that the deal was an excellent bargain.
Many fans say that Rivera is the greatest goalkeeper ever.
Engineers report that graphene may be an ideal coating.
The authors conclude that exercise is a powerful remedy.
I maintain that this was the worst film of the year.
Historians suspect that the letter is a clever forgery.
quiet: Analysts compared the cheapest sources of power.
Researchers ordered this compound from a supplier for trials.
He signed an excellent bargain with the firm.
Many fans met Rivera, the greatest goalkeeper ever, at the airport.
Engineers applied graphene as an ideal coating.
The authors tried a powerful remedy for back pain.
I watched the worst film of the year.
Historians found a clever forgery in the archive.

notes: Probe: 'that the plan is a viable' 0.47, 'may be an even better' 0.49, 'often an indispensable' 0.53, 'I thought Walker was the best' 0.46. Same phrases as objects or appositives 0.005-0.03. Plain 'He will be the next quarterback' only 0.09 and 'Dogs are excellent' 0.004, so the claim framing matters.
